comment: The hostname or IP address of the Elasticsearch 8 server.
modal: The host where the Elasticsearch 8 cluster is reached. Applies only when the search engine is set to Elasticsearch 8.

comment: The TCP port the Elasticsearch 8 server listens on.
modal: The port used to connect to the Elasticsearch 8 server. Applies only when the search engine is set to Elasticsearch 8.

comment: The prefix added to the names of the Elasticsearch 8 indices.
modal: The string prepended to index names in Elasticsearch 8, letting several stores or environments share one cluster without index-name collisions. Applies only when the search engine is set to Elasticsearch 8.

comment: Whether HTTP authentication is used when connecting to Elasticsearch 8.
modal: When Yes, a username and password are sent with requests to the Elasticsearch 8 server. Applies only when the search engine is set to Elasticsearch 8.

comment: The user name for Elasticsearch 8 HTTP authentication.
modal: The account name used to authenticate to the Elasticsearch 8 server. Applies only when Elasticsearch 8 is the search engine and HTTP authentication is enabled.

comment: The password for Elasticsearch 8 HTTP authentication.
modal: The password used together with the user name to authenticate to the Elasticsearch 8 server. Applies only when Elasticsearch 8 is the search engine and HTTP authentication is enabled.

comment: How long, in seconds, to wait for the Elasticsearch 8 server before timing out.
modal: The connection timeout for requests to the Elasticsearch 8 server. Applies only when the search engine is set to Elasticsearch 8.
